package app_test

// Test-only overlay; the ordinary Analytics API assembly owns its database cleanup.
import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/fin-assist/analytics/internal/app/apitest"
	"github.com/fin-assist/analytics/internal/config"
	"net"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestAPIQase90Fixture(t *testing.T) {
	fmt.Println("Q90_STAGE analytics:verified-assembly")
	env := apitest.Start(t, func(c *config.Config) {
		c.Service, c.Env, c.Auth.Mode = "analytics", config.EnvStage, config.AuthVerify
		c.Peers = map[string]string{"user": os.Getenv("Q90_USER")}
		c.Auth.Identity = config.IdentityConfig{UserIssuer: os.Getenv("Q90_USER_ISSUER"), UserAudience: os.Getenv("Q90_USER_AUDIENCE"), StageIssuer: os.Getenv("Q90_STAGE_ISSUER"), StageSigningKeyFile: os.Getenv("Q90_KEY"), StagePublicKeysFile: os.Getenv("Q90_JWKS")}
	})
	lis, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	go func() { _ = env.App.GRPC.Serve(lis) }()
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = lis.Close() })
	fmt.Printf("QASE90 {\"Address\":%q}\n", lis.Addr().String())
	scan := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	for scan.Scan() {
		var query string
		switch scan.Text() {
		case "fail":
			query = `ALTER TABLE recalculation_marker RENAME TO qase90_unavailable_marker`
		case "recover":
			query = `ALTER TABLE qase90_unavailable_marker RENAME TO recalculation_marker`
		case "marker":
			var rows, version int
			if err := env.App.DB.Primary().QueryRow(t.Context(), `SELECT count(*),coalesce(min(requested_version),0) FROM recalculation_marker`).Scan(&rows, &version); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			fmt.Printf("QASE90 {\"Rows\":%d,\"RequestedVersion\":%d}\n", rows, version)
			continue
		case "stop":
			return
		default:
			t.Fatal("unknown Q90 command")
		}
		if _, err := env.App.DB.Primary().Exec(t.Context(), query); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Println("QASE90 {\"OK\":true}")
	}
	if err := scan.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
